violent_crime_rate.label: Violent crime rate
violent_crime_rate.source: FBI Uniform Crime Reporting Program, Return A master files
violent_crime_rate.note: Murder, rape, robbery and aggravated assault reported to police, per 100,000 people. Aggravated assault excludes simple assault. Counts only agencies that reported all 12 months, and divides by the population those agencies serve, not the full county. Left blank when those agencies cover less than 80% of the county's people. Crimes reported by campus, park, transit and drug task force police count in their county but add no residents, which raises those counties' rates. An agency that serves more than one county is split by population. The FBI updates its counts after the file used here, so newer FBI totals can differ. Georgia's figure is built the same way, from every Georgia agency that reported all 12 months (299.2 in 2025). The FBI's own statewide estimate, which also estimates crimes for agencies that did not report, is 296.9.

georgia.note: Same method as the counties, all Georgia local agencies with 12 months of reports. Also the Georgia figure in georgia.
